section.content: The invention discloses a high-energy-density lithium ion battery, which adopts a silicon-based negative electrode and a polymer electrolyte, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a nonaqueous organic solvent, lithium salt, an additive and a polymer dispersed in the electrolyte. The polymer electrolyte can convert the liquid electrolyte in the battery into a gel state with excellent mechanical stability and ion transmission performance after being formed at high temperature. On one hand, the adhesive property of the interface of the silicon-based negative electrode and the diaphragm can be improved, and the interface damage caused by the expansion of the silicon-based negative electrode and the consumption of electrolyte in the circulation process is avoided; on the other hand, the side reaction of the organic solvent on the active surface of the silicon-based negative electrode can be slowed down. The polymer electrolyte can improve the cycle performance of a silicon-based negative electrode lithium ion battery and reduce the thickness expansion rate of the battery in the cycle process.

本发明公开了种高能量密度锂离子电池，该锂离子电池采用硅基负极和聚合物电解液，该聚合物电解液包括非水有机溶剂、锂盐、添加剂及分散在电解液中的聚合物。采用本发明的聚合物电解液可以使电池中的液态电解液经过高温化成后转变成兼具优良力学稳定性和离子传输性能的凝胶态。方面，可以提高硅基负极与隔膜界面的粘结性，避免循环过程中因硅基负极膨胀及电解液消耗引起的界面破坏；另方面，可以减缓有机溶剂在硅基负极的活性表面发生副反应。使用本发明的聚合物电解液可以改善硅基负极锂离子电池的循环性能和降低电池在循环过程中的厚度膨胀率。

Lithium ion batteryTechnical field

The invention belongs to technical field of lithium ion more particularly to a kind of lithium ion battery with high energy densities.

Background technology

The high-energy density of lithium ion battery, long circulation life, wide operating temperature range and it is environmentally protective made its at For the main energy sources of current mobile electronic device.But mobile electronic device especially smart mobile phone was (gentlier, more in recent years It is thin) rapid development, higher demand also is proposed to the energy density of lithium ion battery.

In order to improve the energy density of lithium ion battery, currently used two methods are the work for improving positive electrode respectively Make voltage and using the negative material with more high discharge capacity.Wherein, Si bases negative material is because it is far above graphite cathode The theoretical specific capacity of material makes it become an important development direction for improving lithium ion battery energy density.

However compared with graphite cathode, there are huge bulk effect, this volume effects in cyclic process for silicon-based anode It answers：On the one hand cathode pole piece can be caused to expand so that cathode is deteriorated with the caking property that membrane interface is isolated；On the other hand it can make silicon substrate The solid electrolyte membrane (abbreviation SEI) on negative material surface ruptures during circulating battery, and electrolyte is caused to occur also Original is decomposed, and a large amount of by-product is generated, and deteriorates cycle performance.In addition, the variation of above-mentioned cathode and isolation film interface adhesion and The lasting generation of silicon based anode material surface by-product can cause thickness swelling of the battery in cyclic process increasing.

Invention content

It is an object of the invention to：In view of the deficiencies of the prior art, a kind of lithium ion battery with high energy density is provided, the lithium Ion battery has excellent cycle performance, and the thickness swelling in cyclic process does not dramatically increase.

The present invention provides a kind of lithium ion battery, which uses silicon-based anode and polyelectrolyte.

The active material of the silicon-based anode is mixture or all silica-base materials of carbon material and silica-base material. It, can by introducing silica-base material in negative electrode active material since the gram volume of silica-base material will be far above the gram volume of carbon material To significantly improve the gram volume of cathode, to improve the energy density of lithium ion battery.

The silica-base material is nano-silicon, Si oxide, Si-C composite material, one kind in silicon alloy material or several Kind.Preferably, the silica-base material is selected as Si oxide SiO, and the mass percentage of the silica-base material is less than more than 0 30%.Preferably, the upper limit value of the mass percentage of the silica-base material is 10%, 15%, 20% or 25%；The silicon substrate The lower limiting value of the mass percentage of material is 5%, 10% or 15%.

The polyelectrolyte, including non-aqueous organic solvent, lithium salts, the polymerization of additive and dispersion in the electrolytic solution Object, it is characterised in that the polymer is the mixture of Carboxylic Acid Fibre element and Fluorine containing olefine polymer.

Monomer need not be used relative to conventional gel electrolyte, in polyelectrolyte preparation process of the invention, drawn Agent is sent out, unreacted monomer is not present, initiator need not be preserved；And electrolyte does not have to exposure in air, it need not be stringent Dry environment, do not consume additional solvent, production cost is low.The present invention by directly introducing solvable polymerization in the electrolytic solution Object so that polymer is completely dissolved and is uniformly mixed in the electrolytic solution, is then injected into battery core, in high temperature formation process In, with the consumption of liquid electrolyte, the polymer of battery core inner homogeneous dispersion can be physical crosslinking mutually winding and be formed Gel state.

After being introduced separately into Carboxylic Acid Fibre element in liquid electrolyte, battery can form gel state electrolysis by high temperature chemical conversion Liquid, being formed by gel state electrolyte has relatively good thermal stability and mechanical strength, but its ion transmission performance is bad； Partial fluorine ethylene polymer is introduced separately into liquid electrolyte, battery can also form gel state after high temperature is melted into, be formed Gel state electrolyte although there is relatively good ion transmission performance, its mechanical property is bad.The present invention passes through in liquid Carboxylic Acid Fibre element and partial fluorine ethylene polymer are introduced in state electrolyte simultaneously, two kinds of polymer molecule is in battery high-temperature formation process In can interact, compound state gel can be formed to be formed by gel state electrolyte and be provided simultaneously with relatively good mechanics and stablize Property and ion transmission performance.

The Carboxylic Acid Fibre element is in cellulose acetate propionate, acetylbutyrylcellulose, cellulose propionate butyrate One or several kinds of combinations.

The Fluorine containing olefine polymer is selected from Kynoar, gathers inclined fluoropropene, vinylidene and hexafluoropropylene copolymer In one or several kinds of combinations.

The molecular weight of the polymer is 5000~120000.

The mass percentage of the polymer in the electrolytic solution is 4%~15%.If content is less than 4%, battery passes through High temperature chemical conversion can not form gel state.If content is more than 15%, polymer is easy to reunite and can not disperse in the electrolytic solution, no Uniform electrolyte can be prepared.

As an improvement of the present invention, the additive contains vinyl trialkyl oxysilane, matter in the electrolytic solution It is 0.1%~2% to measure percentage composition.Preferably, the vinyl trialkyl oxysilane be selected from vinyltrimethoxysilane or Person's vinyltriethoxysilane.

The vinyl trialkyl oxysilane can significantly increase Carboxylic Acid Fibre element and Fluorine containing olefine in battery forming process The physical crosslinking effect of polymer between the two；In addition, vinyl trialkyl oxysilane can be in silicon substrate in battery forming process Electrochemical reaction occurs for material surface, further enhances the phase interaction being formed by between gel state electrolyte and silica-base material With, be conducive to further improve battery performance.

Non-aqueous organic solvent in the electrolyte is ethylene carbonate, propene carbonate, dimethyl carbonate, carbonic acid diethyl Ester, dipropyl carbonate, methyl ethyl carbonate, methyl formate, Ethyl formate, ethyl propionate, propyl propionate, methyl butyrate, acetic acid second Ester, acid anhydrides, N-Methyl pyrrolidone, N-METHYLFORMAMIDE, N- methylacetamides, acetonitrile, sulfolane, dimethyl sulfoxide, ethylene are sub- Sulfuric ester, propylene sulfite, methyl sulfide, diethyl sulfite, dimethyl sulfite, tetrahydrofuran, fluorine-containing ring-type are organic At least two in ester, sulphur-containing cyclic organic ester.

Lithium salts in the polyelectrolyte includes：LiPF6、LiBF4、LiTFSI、LiClO4、LiAsF6、LiBOB、 LiDFOB、LiTFOB、LiN(SO2RF)2、LiN(SO2F)(SO2RF), wherein substituent RFFor RF=CnF2n+1Saturation perfluor alkane Base, the integer that n is 1~10, and 2n+1 is more than zero integer.The lithium salt is 0.5M~2M.Lithium salt is too low, electrolysis The conductivity of liquid is low, can influence the multiplying power and cycle performance of entire battery system；Lithium salt is excessively high, and electrolysis fluid viscosity is excessive, Equally influence the multiplying power of entire battery system.Preferred lithium salt is 0.9~1.3M.

Additive in the polyelectrolyte contains film for additive well known to art technology, is selected from carbonic acid Asia second Enester (VC), vinylethylene carbonate (VEC), fluorinated ethylene carbonate (FEC), propane sultone (PS), in butane sulfonic acid One or more of ester (BS), sulfuric acid vinyl ester (DTD), adiponitrile (ADN), succinonitrile (SN).

The mass percentage of film for additive in the electrolytic solution in the polyelectrolyte is 1%~25%.

The addition of film for additive, is conducive in battery forming process, forms passivating film in positive and negative pole surface, improves battery Cycle performance and high-temperature storage performance.

Preferably, the film for additive contains FEC and PS.

The positive electrode active materials of the lithium ion battery are selected from lithium and cobalt oxides, lithium nickel oxide, lithium manganese oxide, lithium nickel At least one of Mn oxide, lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide and lithium nickel cobalt aluminum oxide.

Compared with the existing technology, the invention has the advantages that：

For negative effect caused by volume expansion in silicon-based anode cyclic process, by being added in conventional electrolysis liquid The mixture of Carboxylic Acid Fibre element and Fluorine containing olefine polymer can be such that the liquid electrolyte in battery changes after high temperature is melted into At the gel state for having both excellent mechanical stability and ion transmission performance.On the one hand, silicon-based anode and diaphragm interface can be improved Caking property, avoid in cyclic process because silicon-based anode expansion and electrolyte consume caused by interfacial failure；It on the other hand, can be with Side reaction occurs for the active surface for slowing down organic solvent in silicon-based anode.Polyelectrolyte using the present invention can improve silicon Thickness swelling of the cycle performance and reduction battery of base negative electrode lithium ion battery in cyclic process.Three alkane of additive vinyl Oxysilane can significantly increase the physics of Carboxylic Acid Fibre element and Fluorine containing olefine polymer between the two in battery forming process and hand over Connection acts on；In addition, in battery forming process on silica-base material surface electrochemical reaction can occur for vinyl trialkyl oxysilane, The interaction being formed by between gel state electrolyte and silica-base material is further enhanced, is conducive to further improve battery Performance.

Specific implementation mode

With reference to embodiment, the application is expanded on further.It should be understood that these embodiments be merely to illustrate the application without For limiting scope of the present application.

The preparation of 1~9 battery of embodiment 1~13 and comparative example

The preparation of liquid electrolyte：By ethylene carbonate (EC), propene carbonate (PC) and diethyl carbonate (DEC) with matter Amount compares EC:PC:DEC=20:20:60 mixing, are added the lithium hexafluoro phosphate (LiPF of certain mass6) so that it is in the electrolytic solution A concentration of 1mol/L；In addition the fluorinated ethylene carbonate (FEC) for being also 15% added with mass percentage content in electrolyte, matter Measure the propane sultone (PS) that degree is 5%.

The preparation of polyelectrolyte：According to the quality of polymer and vinyl trialkyl oxysilane in liquid electrolyte Polymer and vinyl trialkyl oxysilane are added in liquid electrolyte by percentage, and stirring makes polymer powders be completely dissolved In the electrolytic solution to get to polyelectrolyte.

The preparation of anode pole piece：Cobalt acid lithium, conductive carbon black (Super P), binder polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) are pressed Mass ratio 97:1.4:1.6 are made lithium ion battery anode glue size with N-Methyl pyrrolidone (NMP) mixing, are coated on collector On aluminium foil；It is cold-pressed after being dried at 85 DEG C；Then it after carrying out trimming, cut-parts, slitting, is dried under 85 DEG C of vacuum condition Anode slice of lithium ion battery is made in 4h, soldering polar ear.

The preparation of cathode pole piece：It will be as the graphite of negative electrode active material and SiO and conductive carbon black (Super P), thickening Agent carboxymethyl sodium cellulosate (being abbreviated as CMC), bonding agent polyacrylic acid (being abbreviated as PAA) in mass ratio 92:1.0:1.0:5 with it is pure Slurry is made in water purification mixing, is coated on copper foil of affluxion body and is dried at 85 DEG C；Then after carrying out trimming, cut-parts, slitting, 12h is dried under 120 DEG C of vacuum conditions, lithium ion battery negative electrode is made in soldering polar ear.

The preparation of lithium ion battery：Using polyethylene (being abbreviated as PE) porous polymer film as diaphragm；By anode obtained Piece, diaphragm, negative plate are folded in order, and diaphragm is made to be among positive/negative plate, and winding obtains naked battery core；Naked battery core is placed in outer In packaging, the liquid electrolyte of above-mentioned preparation or polyelectrolyte are injected into the battery after drying, encapsulation stands, changes At (0.02C constant-current charges to 3.4V, then with 0.1C constant-current charges to 3.85V), shaping, volume test, lithium ion battery is completed Preparation (thickness 4.2mm, width 34mm, the length 82mm of soft-package battery).

It analyzes known to comparative example 1~8：When introducing SiO in negative electrode active material, lithium ion battery can be significantly improved Energy density, when the SiO contents in negative electrode active material reach 30%, energy density is maximum, can reach 753Wh/L, But after adding SiO in negative electrode active material, the thickness in the circulation volume conservation rate of lithium ion battery and cyclic process Expansion rate deteriorates obvious, and with the increase of SiO contents in negative electrode active material, deterioration degree is more apparent.

It analyzes known to comparative example 6 and embodiment 3~20：When addition Carboxylic Acid Fibre element and Fluorine containing olefine in liquid electrolyte The circulation volume conservation rate of lithium ion battery can be significantly improved after the mixture of polymer, and is substantially reduced circulating battery mistake Thickness swelling in journey.It, can by adding the mixture of Carboxylic Acid Fibre element and Fluorine containing olefine polymer in conventional electrolysis liquid So that the liquid electrolyte in battery is transformed into after high temperature is melted into has both excellent mechanical stability and ion transmission performance Gel state.On the one hand, the caking property that can improve silicon-based anode and diaphragm interface avoids in cyclic process because silicon-based anode expands And interfacial failure caused by electrolyte consumption；On the other hand, the active surface that can slow down organic solvent in silicon-based anode occurs Side reaction.It can improve the cycle performance of silicon-based anode lithium ion battery using the polyelectrolyte of the present invention and reduce battery Thickness swelling in cyclic process.

Analysis Examples 1 to 6 can be seen that：Polymer content in polyelectrolyte must control in a certain range Competence exertion goes out its improvement to battery performance.When the polymer content in polyelectrolyte is less than 4%, electricity is dismantled Pond finds the non-gel of electrolyte；When the polymer content in polyelectrolyte is higher than 15%, due to polymer agglomeration Seriously, electrolyte can not be prepared.Circulation volume conservation rate and thickness of the polymer content to lithium ion battery in polyelectrolyte Degree expansion rate shows different affecting laws.When the polymer content in liquid electrolyte increases to 6% by 4%, lithium from The capacity retention ratio of sub- battery is improved significantly, and the capacity retention ratio that cycle is 300 times is increased to 86.2% by 82.1%, still When continuing growing the mass percentage of polymer in liquid electrolyte, the circulation volume conservation rate of lithium ion battery starts to drop It is low, nonetheless, when the mass percentage of liquid electrolyte polymer is increased to 15%, relative to the liquid for not adding polymer The circulation volume conservation rate of state electrolyte, lithium ion battery still has improvement.In addition, the cycle thickness swelling of lithium ion battery with The increase of polymer quality percentage composition in liquid electrolyte significantly reduces.

Embodiment 4 and embodiment 7~11 are analyzed it is found that the molecular weight of the polymer in polyelectrolyte must also control Its improvement to battery of competence exertion in a certain range.When the molecular weight of polymer is too small, polymer molecule can not Full cross-linked formation reticular structure, to not can effectively improve the thickness swelling during circulating battery；When point of polymer When son amount is excessive, transmission rate of the lithium ion in pole piece can be reduced by being formed by cross-linked structure, to deteriorate cyclicity Energy.

It analyzes comparative example 9~10 and embodiment 4,12~15 can be seen that：The Carboxylic Acid Fibre element that is added in electrolyte and The ratio of Fluorine containing olefine polymer also has an impact the cycle performance and cycle thickness swelling of lithium ion battery.Reason may be In electrolyte add different proportion polymer can make battery high-temperature be melted into after gel state have different mechanical properties and from Sub- transmission performance.

Embodiment 4 and embodiment 21~25 are analyzed it is found that at the same time containing Carboxylic Acid Fibre element and Fluorine containing olefine polymer Vinyl trialkyl oxysilane is introduced in polyelectrolyte can further improve the cycle appearance of silicon-based anode lithium ion battery It measures conservation rate and reduces the thickness swelling in cyclic process.
